## 0.5.1

- Meetings now record the call wherever it plays. Before, Dicta only heard the Windows default output, so calls played on another device (a headset picked in Discord, or a GoXLR's Chat channel) were missed. A new Call audio setting in Meetings lets you pick Call apps (the default), All outputs, Windows default, or one device.
- Call apps records only your call apps (Discord, Zoom, Teams, Slack, Webex, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Skype and a few more) and your browser (for Google Meet), on whichever output they play, so game audio and music stay out of your notes and a virtual mixer can't record the call twice. If none of these apps is running or can be recorded, or your Windows is older than Windows 10 2004, Dicta records all outputs instead. If none of them has been heard a minute after recording starts, Dicta also records all outputs until one is.
- A call audio device that keeps failing right after it opens is now retried less often, and Dicta switches to all outputs and warns you instead of retrying it forever. A device that keeps dropping out no longer shows a notice every time.
